_comment: Paths are relative to app/data (git-ignored local GenBank files). `references` is a list: a multi-reference run only adds entries; single-reference runs use the first.

prrs.notes: Overlapping ORFs; ORF1b is a -1 frameshift product with no ATG start of its own.

fmd.notes: Single polyprotein; mature peptides, no codon check.

ped.notes: PED_ref_2.gb is available as a second reference for multi-reference runs.
